source: Photochrom Collection of the Zentralbibliothek Zürich, Zenodo v1.1, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24141227 (metadata CC0)

excluded.rule: records starting after 1914 are excluded: photochrom production ended 1914

fields.y0/y1: first/last year from date_of_publication_or_production_standardised; null if not parseable
fields.df: date flag, see date_flag() in scripts/build_catalog.py. Production period 1889-1914 : 'open' = open end (y0/9999), y1 set to 1914; 'capped' = ends after 1914, y1 set to 1914; 'suspect' = probably a typo in the catalogue, left uncorrected and excluded by the date filter. The catalogued date is always in 'd'.
fields.s: subset: r = recatalogued (IIIF), l = legacy (no IIIF)
fields.c: present-day countries derived from GND area codes of all place mentions (photochrom-places.csv); method: scripts/build_catalog.py, rule-based, unreviewed
fields.f: bit mask of image content flags, order as in 'features'; machine-generated, unreviewed
fields.iiif: IIIF Image API base URL of the first image (recatalogued only)
fields.n: Photochrom number printed on the print (photochrom_number, see docs/data.md; rule-based, unreviewed)
fields.img: image file name without extension (Zenodo image ZIPs); also the identifier on the thumbnail IIIF service
fields.ar: aspect ratio (width / height) of the whole scan, from data/image-sizes.csv
fields.art: match_status in artwork-pairs.csv (record reproduces a painting)
